alef.keywords: balance, mediation, intellect, breathing, connection, air
alef.interpretation: The mediating soul that connects and balances. Substrate of the soul that allows broad intellectual understanding. Work in the chest and breathing.

mem.keywords: depth, emotion, receptivity, interior, fluidity, water
mem.interpretation: The deep and receptive soul. Oriented toward the interior and emotions. Work in the belly and emotions. Descent, inner gestation.

shin.interpretation: The expansive and mental soul. Oriented toward the heights and intellectual clarity. Work in the head and mind. Great mental changes.

bet.keywords: limits, time, wisdom, restriction, karma, discipline
bet.interpretation: Planet of limits and wisdom trials. Brings deep wisdom or stubborn foolishness depending on tikún. You harvest what you sow.

gimel.keywords: expansion, justice, abundance, spiritual journeys, teaching, learning
gimel.interpretation: Planet of expansion and abundance. Possible wealth or poverty depending on how its duality is worked. Spiritual journeys.

dalet.keywords: action, conflict, energy, decision, surgery, competition
dalet.interpretation: Planet of active energy and conflicts. Fertility or desolation depending on challenge resolution. Urgent decisions.

kaf.keywords: identity, vitality, leadership, visibility, recognition, life
kaf.interpretation: Planet of identity and full life. The self is exposed to the world. Life or death depending on soul vitality. Leadership.

pe.keywords: relationships, art, harmony, money, affection, power
pe.interpretation: Planet of relationships and art. Constructive dominance or servitude depending on affective and power choices. Harmony or rupture.

resh.keywords: communication, contracts, studies, messages, movement, exchange
resh.interpretation: Planet of communication and movement. Peace or war depending on honest or deceptive language use. Studies and messages.

tav.keywords: cycles, emotions, domestic, changing, feminine, intuition
tav.interpretation: Planet of cycles and emotions. What flows and changes ceaselessly. Grace or ugliness depending on sensitivity. The domestic.

he.keywords: speech, expression, initiation, communication, word, beginning
he.interpretation: The faculty of speech as soul instrument. What is said or not said defines the course of situations. Initiation and beginnings.

vav.keywords: thought, reflection, rooting, consolidation, slowness, stability
vav.interpretation: Thought as primary action mode. Year of slow reflection and mental consolidation. Rooting and stability.

zayin.keywords: movement, change, duality, displacement, versatility, adaptation
zayin.interpretation: Movement dominates the soul. Year of displacements, changes, and active dualities. Versatility and adaptation.

jet.keywords: vision, perception, illusion, revelation, intuition, clarity
jet.interpretation: Vision as key faculty. Year of perception, visual revelations or illusions. Clarity or visual confusion.

tet.keywords: hearing, listening, leadership, visibility, revelation, authority
tet.interpretation: Hearing leads the soul. Listening (or not) is the axis of the year and situations. Visibility and leadership.

yod.keywords: action, work, detail, service, method, perfection
yod.interpretation: Concrete action defines the soul. Year of methodical work, service, and attention to detail. Perfection and method.

lamed.keywords: union, relationships, alliances, contracts, balance, partnership
lamed.interpretation: Union is central to the soul. Relationships, alliances, and life contracts define the course. Balance and harmony.

nun.keywords: smell, instinct, hidden, depth, transformation, mystery
nun.interpretation: Smell-instinct guides the soul. Year of deep perception where the hidden comes to light. Transformation and mystery.

samej.keywords: dream, vision, direction, spirituality, travel, expansion
samej.interpretation: Dream orients the soul. Inner visions and sense of spiritual direction guide the year. Travels and expansion.

ayin.keywords: anger, authority, trial, discipline, mastery, structure
ayin.interpretation: Anger or its mastery is the soul theme. Year of emotional trial and authority development. Discipline and structure.

tzadi.keywords: swallowing, assimilation, acceptance, rejection, processing, integration
tzadi.interpretation: Swallowing/asimilation defines the soul. What is accepted or rejected from life marks the path. Integration of experiences.

kof.keywords: laughter, humor, dissolution, detachment, grace, compassion
kof.interpretation: Laughter/cosmic humor guides the soul. Year of dissolution, detachment, and divine grace. Compassion and surrender.

love.alef: Alef invites cultivating shared balance as foundation of the loving bond. Love, like Air, requires conscious mediation and reciprocal openness; affective wealth must circulate between both parties.
love.mem: The emotional depth of Mem claims authentic connection and receptivity in your love life. It is time to descend into the depths of feeling with courage toward true union.
love.shin: Shin indicates that your relationship may be exposed to transformative mental forces. Protect the bond with clarity and face obstacles together.
love.bet: Bet reminds that love requires patience and wisdom. Saturn's limits in relationships are not obstacles but the structure that allows lasting bonds to be built over time.
love.gimel: Gimel announces expansion and abundance in your love life. Jupiter's energy brings opportunities for growth, but remember that true wealth in relationships comes from honest reciprocity.
love.dalet: Dalet warns that conflicts may arise in your relationship. Mars' energy requires action and courage; face challenges together rather than avoiding them.
love.kaf: Kaf illuminates your love life with solar energy of identity and visibility. It is a moment to express yourself authentically and let the relationship shine in its true light.
love.pe: Pe indicates that harmony and balance are key in your relationship. Venus invites cultivating fair exchange and mutual appreciation as foundation of lasting bonds.
love.resh: Resh makes honest communication the pillar of your relationship. Words expressed with truth and those heard with attention weave the most lasting bond.
love.tav: Tav invites emotional flow and sensitivity in your love life. The Moon's cycles remind that relationships have their seasons; trust the natural rhythm.
love.he: He makes speech the foundation of your relationship. Words expressed with truth create the most lasting bond; speak with intention and listen with attention.
love.vav: Vav proposes that your love path advance with thoughtful reflection. It is not blind impulse, but movement aligned with deep understanding that strengthens the union.
love.zayin: Zayin indicates that your relationship is in active movement and change. Adaptability and openness to new experiences will strengthen the bond.
love.jet: Jet illuminates your love life with the clarity of perception. Deep understanding of the other is the basis of a relationship that transcends the superficial.
love.tet: Tet calls you to listen deeply in your relationship. Hearing the other's truth is the key for the bond to emerge renewed.
love.yod: Yod indicates that concrete actions define your love life. Small acts of service and attention build the most solid foundations.
love.lamed: Lamed reminds that true love is sacred union: every bond creates responsibility that balances the relationship. Ensure that giving and receiving flow with equity.
love.nun: Nun invites trusting instinct and deep perception to navigate heart matters. The hidden dimensions of love contain wisdom that reason cannot see.
love.samej: Samej indicates that love is in a period of vision and direction. Inner insights about the relationship will guide you toward the right path.
love.ayin: Ayin calls you to work on emotional mastery in your relationship. The discipline of love transforms challenges into opportunities for growth.
love.tzadi: Tzadi indicates that assimilation and acceptance are key in your relationship. Accept what is and integrate the lessons that love brings.
love.kof: Kof invites letting go with grace and humor in your love life. Detachment from expectations allows love to flow naturally.
love.default: This letter bears the wisdom of the Sefer Yetzirah and manifests in your love life with a message that deserves deep contemplation.

career.alef: Alef indicates that your career path requires balance and mediation. The intellectual clarity of Air will help you navigate professional challenges with wisdom.
career.mem: Mem invites emotional depth and receptivity in your professional life. Intuition and the ability to connect deeply with others are your greatest assets now.
career.shin: Shin calls you to expand your mental horizons in the work. Clarity of thought and the ability to see the big picture will lead to breakthroughs.
career.bet: Bet reminds that career success requires discipline and patience. Saturn's energy rewards those who build solid foundations over time.
career.gimel: Gimel announces expansion and abundance in your professional path. Jupiter's energy brings opportunities for growth and advancement.
career.dalet: Dalet calls you to act with courage and determination in your career. Mars' energy is the fuel you need to overcome obstacles.
career.kaf: Kaf illuminates your professional path with solar energy of leadership. It is a moment to take initiative and let your talents shine.
career.pe: Pe indicates that harmony and cooperation are key in your professional life. Venus invites building alliances based on fair exchange.
career.resh: Resh indicates that clear communication and precise transmission of knowledge are your greatest professional assets now.
career.tav: Tav invites adaptability and emotional intelligence in your work. The Moon's cycles remind that professional life has its seasons.
career.default: This letter bears the wisdom of the Sefer Yetzirah and manifests in your career with a message that deserves deep contemplation.

health.alef: Alef links health with conscious management of breathing as resource. Physical well-being requires active care of breath and balance.
health.mem: Mem calls to attend to emotional health and the fluid systems of the body. Water's healing power is available through rest and receptivity.
health.shin: Shin calls you to build mental clarity and vitality. The energy of Fire in the head can be transformative for cognitive health.
health.bet: Bet reminds that health requires discipline and patience. Saturn's energy supports those who build healthy habits over time.
health.gimel: Gimel announces expansion of vitality and well-being. Jupiter's energy brings opportunities for healing and growth.
health.dalet: Dalet calls you to act with courage in your health habits. Mars' energy is the fuel you need to overcome physical challenges.
health.kaf: Kaf contributes solar energy to your healing process. Vital force is available; tune into it through light and movement.
health.pe: Pe indicates that harmony and balance are key for health. Venus invites cultivating fair exchange between body, mind, and spirit.
health.resh: Resh indicates that clear communication with your body —listening to its signals— is fundamental for healing.
health.tav: Tav invites emotional healing and honoring natural cycles. The Moon's energy supports those who respect the rhythm of rest and activity.
health.default: This letter bears the wisdom of the Sefer Yetzirah and manifests in your health with a message that deserves deep contemplation.

path.alef: Alef indicates that your life path requires balance and mediation. The intellectual clarity of Air will help you navigate life's challenges with wisdom.
path.mem: Mem invites emotional depth and receptivity on your path. Intuition and the ability to connect deeply with your purpose are your greatest guides.
path.shin: Shin calls you to expand your mental horizons and seek clarity of vision. The transformative energy of Fire will illuminate your path.
path.bet: Bet reminds that your path requires discipline and patience. Saturn's energy rewards those who build solid foundations over time.
path.gimel: Gimel announces expansion and abundance on your path. Jupiter's energy brings opportunities for growth and spiritual advancement.
path.dalet: Dalet calls you to act with courage and determination on your path. Mars' energy is the fuel you need to overcome obstacles.
path.kaf: Kaf illuminates your path with solar energy of leadership and visibility. It is a moment to take initiative and shine your light.
path.pe: Pe indicates that harmony and balance are key on your path. Venus invites cultivating fair exchanges and meaningful connections.
path.resh: Resh indicates that clear communication and the transmission of wisdom are your greatest assets on your path.
path.tav: Tav invites adaptability and honoring natural cycles on your path. The Moon's energy supports those who respect life's rhythms.
path.default: This letter bears the wisdom of the Sefer Yetzirah and manifests on your path with a message that deserves deep contemplation.

general.default: This letter bears the wisdom of the Sefer Yetzirah and manifests in your situation with a message that deserves deep contemplation.
